decisions.reason: White-label test pressings are low-cost, limited collector items that fit the curated catalog, and with industry turnover growing and no signal of a shortfall against aspirations, management has no trigger for problemistic search, though such limited series tend to run out naturally.

A German new wave compilation series sits close to the in-house label's core competence and serves the collector base, so with satisfactory industry conditions and slack to carry uncertain results, management keeps it while it gathers more performance evidence.
